assumptions.choice: Used a 5-bar window Zigzag pivot detection algorithm to identify alternating high/low swing points and verify 5-wave impulse structures with wave 3 Fib expansion checks.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires automatic counting of 5-wave impulse structures on daily OHLC data; algorithmic swing point tracking provides a deterministic structure.

assumptions.choice: Implemented Double Bottom / Inverse Head & Shoulders for bullish setups, and Double Top / Head & Shoulders for bearish setups using recent pivot structure within a 3% price tolerance.
assumptions.reason: The spec explicitly mentions these key classic chart patterns as examples of confirmation patterns.

assumptions.topic: Breakout and Fib Bounce Signal Trigger
assumptions.choice: Triggered long/short entry on daily close breaking above/below pattern neckline or bouncing 1% off pattern extreme.
assumptions.reason: The spec defines entry on neckline breakout or bounce from key level at completion of 5th wave.

assumptions.choice: Calculated position size so total risk equals 2% of portfolio value based on distance to pattern extreme stop-loss, capped by available cash.
assumptions.reason: Direct implementation of the rule requiring stop-loss size to be no more than 2% of account balance per trade.

assumptions.choice: Exited on reaching 161.8% pattern height target, hitting stop-loss extreme, or upon opposite signal formation.
assumptions.reason: Fulfills spec requirements for take-profit targeting, key support/resistance breach exit, and trend-reversal exit.
